name: LEDGER-4
author: David Ryan
tagline: a tracker: song, chain, phrase, commands
description: LEDGER-4 is a tracker for the FM-1 in the line of Little Sound DJ: a song of chains, chains of phrases with transpose, phrases of 16 rows of note, instrument, velocity and a command (arpeggio, chance, delay, kill, retrigger, slide, tempo, hop, filter, CC, random, groove, echo). Four tracks play its own synth and drums and go out over USB and Bluetooth MIDI.
credits: Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments). After Little Sound DJ and the Dirtywave M8. Fonts: Barlow (SIL OFL 1.1).
